summary: If jobs stop syncing to automation dashboard after an upgrade, an interrupted sync job is stuck: connect to the aapdashboard database with psql, find rows in scheduler_syncjob still pending, waiting or running after a minute, and delete them by id.
questions: Automation dashboard not syncing new jobs after upgrade
How do I delete stuck sync jobs in automation dashboard?

answer_card.title: Clear stuck automation dashboard sync jobs
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=<dashboard_pg_password> psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U aapdashboard -d aapdashboard
```
```sql
SELECT * FROM scheduler_syncjob WHERE status IN ('pending','waiting','running');
-- wait a minute, run again; IDs still listed are stuck
DELETE from scheduler_syncjob WHERE id IN (<id>);
```
Refresh the dashboard to confirm sync resumed.
